page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at 3.3 GHz. It features 24 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing a total of 24 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.hfg7.6xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and memory operations. The instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 25408.19 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 10254.0. Memory performance is a notable strength, with the PassMark memory score of 2847.06 ranking in the top 25% tier. Read-only memory bandwidth for small cached blocks reached 1393.09 GB/sec, while uncached large-block read and write bandwidths were measured at 90.69 GB/sec and 53.33 GB/sec, respectively. For database operations, the server processed 24.01 million Redis SET operations per second.

The absence of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware limits the instance's utility for heavy storage-bound databases or deep learning training workloads. However, the dedicated core allocation and strong memory performance make it suitable for workloads such as software compilation, where it scored 20775.0 on Geekbench, as well as static web serving, which registered a throughput of 18.38 GB/sec. It also supports moderate machine learning inference, processing 11.92 text generation tokens per second on a 7B parameter model. The instance represents a balanced general-purpose profile with dedicated compute resources.
